boundary.description: From the point on the Manchester, Bolton and Bury Canal opposite Lavender Street, by a beeline SE to Ringley Road West (A667), including Shore Top Farm, but excluding Mount Sion House. E by Rigley Road West to its junction with Wood Street S and by Bury – Bolton District boundary, then W by Salford – Bolton District boundary to Cedar Drive and by a beeline to M60 Motorway near junction 15. W by a M60 & M61 Motorway to M61 junction 3 to the point M61 Motorway (Kearsley Spur) meets Moss Road near Kearsley Academy. Then NE by a beeline to Stoneclough Road (A667) and along Stoneclough Road to Kearsley Station. Then by a beeline N to and W along River Irwell to the point opposite Mount Sion Road and by a beeline to Manchester, Bolton and Bury Canal.
